cmd:
crontab -l > /tmp/cron_old.txt
grep -v "vps_pipeline.py\|vps_satellite_pipeline.py" /tmp/cron_old.txt > /tmp/cron_new.txt
echo "*/5 * * * * bash -c 'S=\$(date +%s); /usr/bin/python3 /opt/weather-pipeline/repo/scripts/vps_pipeline.py >> /var/log/vps-pipeline.log 2>&1; E=\$(date +%s); echo \"[\$(date -u +%FT%TZ)] main duration: \$((E-S))s\" >> /var/log/vps-durations.log'" >> /tmp/cron_new.txt
echo "2,7,12,17,22,27,32,37,42,47,52,57 * * * * bash -c 'S=\$(date +%s); /usr/bin/python3 /opt/weather-pipeline/repo/scripts/vps_satellite_pipeline.py >> /var/log/vps-satellite-pipeline.log 2>&1; E=\$(date +%s); echo \"[\$(date -u +%FT%TZ)] satellite duration: \$((E-S))s\" >> /var/log/vps-durations.log'" >> /tmp/cron_new.txt
crontab /tmp/cron_new.txt
echo '--- crontab now ---'
crontab -l
